items.summary: Visa Inc. (NYSE:V) announced on Tuesday that it expanded its Agentic Ready program to include merchants, payment service providers (PSPs), acquirers and commerce platforms, helping them prepare for transactions initiated by AI agents. The initiative, part of Visa Intelligent Commerce, launched with more than 140 participants, including Adyen, Antom, Billtrust, Checkout.com, Fiserv, Global Payments, PayPal and Stripe. items.title: PayPal Holdings (PYPL) Expands AI Driven Token Payments Acceptance
items.summary: PayPal Holdings (NasdaqGS: PYPL) has partnered with Visa to expand support for AI-driven agentic token payments. The collaboration aims to let AI agents initiate tokenized Visa payments through PayPal's wallet and merchant acceptance network. The move aligns PayPal with sector wide efforts to build secure, programmable payment rails for autonomous digital transactions.
